name: lastra-vscode
description: Show workspace context and run configured tasks on the Lastra deck.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Lastra can display workspace information. Launching tasks requires VS Code Workspace Trust.

lastra.enabled.description: Publish local workspace state to the Lastra deck.

lastra.allowedTasks.description: Names of workspace tasks that Lastra can run. Use this setting only for tasks you want on the deck.

lastra.jestReport.description: Optional Jest JSON results path, relative to the active workspace folder.
